September 25, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-25-1971-54698

The US Consul General Herbert Daniel Spivak meets Jamaat leader Abbas Ali Khan.

Pakistan’s Foreign Secretary Sultan Mohammad sends a letter to the UN Secretary General protesting India’s intervention into Pakistan’s “internal” matter. He also criticises those who stands beside India’s course of action.
